title: Give
intro: Financial gifts support worship, outreach, care for our buildings, and the shared ministry of Epiphany.

sections.heading: Give online
sections.text: Use the Give Online button below to make a secure contribution through our online giving provider Tithely. You can make a one-time gift or create a recurring gifts. Use your debit/credit card or your checking account. Use of your checking account incurs less fees.

sections.heading: Other ways to give
sections.text: Gifts may also be made by check or through other arrangements with the parish. Contact the church if you need assistance. Checks should be made out to "Church of the Epiphany".
